title: Local null-homotopies from bounded finite free constant complexes into acyclic complexes
statement: Let U be a scheme with small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], B a commutative ring, and P a cochain complex of B-modules indexed by the integers. Suppose there are integers a,b such that P^n is zero whenever n<a or b<n, and for each n there is a natural number r_n and an isomorphism P^n ≅ B^(r_n). Let E be the termwise constant sheaf complex [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], F any acyclic cochain complex of sheaves of B-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] (acyclic means every cohomology object [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is zero), and alpha:E -> F a chain map. There is a jointly surjective etale cover (u_j:U_j -> U)_j, indexed in the universe of U, on every member of which u_j^*(alpha) is chain homotopic to zero. No bound on F or finiteness of B is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the additive constant sheaf functor termwise to the finite free isomorphisms and zero terms. Thus E^n is isomorphic to the constant sheaf on B^(r_n), and is zero outside [a,b]. Start with the zero degree-minus-one cochain, whose homotopy equations hold above b because those source terms are zero.

source.place: Tag 08FP, lemma-local-homotopy, assertion (1), finite free constant specialization; local basis lifts are Tag 08FN.

proof.text: Suppose a degree-minus-one cochain h satisfies alpha^n=d_E^n h^(n+1)+h^n d_F^(n-1) for n>k. Define z=alpha^k-d_E^k h^(k+1). The chain map equation and the homotopy equation at k+1 give z followed by d_F^k equal to zero. Factor z through cycles Z^k(F). Acyclicity gives an epimorphism F^(k-1) -> Z^k(F), using HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.epi_toCycles in the proved source-library API.

source.place: Tag 08FP, lemma-local-homotopy, assertion (1), finite free constant specialization; local basis lifts are Tag 08FN.

proof.text: Transport the finite free isomorphism of E^k and apply [lem-pc-finite-free-constant-local-lift] to the cycle map. On an etale cover this supplies t:E^k -> F^(k-1) with t followed by d_F equal to z. Replace the k-th component of h by t; concretely add a single-component cochain t-h^k. The homotopy equation now holds at k and remains unchanged in all larger degrees.

source.place: Tag 08FP, lemma-local-homotopy, assertion (1), finite free constant specialization; local basis lifts are Tag 08FN.

proof.text: Repeat the preceding step max(b-a+1,0) times, using natural-number induction and binding covers. Exact inverse image preserves acyclicity and transports the finite free isomorphisms. The canonical upperStarComp natural isomorphism transports each twice-restricted cochain back to the restriction along the composite cover arrow. Its naturality proves every homotopy equation after transport. Finally all equations at n>=a hold by induction; those below a hold because E^n is zero. Cochain.equivHomotopy converts the resulting differential equation to an actual chain homotopy. If a>b the initial zero cochain already suffices. Rank zero and the empty scheme are handled by the same construction.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteFree_etale_acyclic_homotopy
    (U : Scheme.{u}) (B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing B]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) ℤ)
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n))
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ r : ℕ,
      Nonempty (P.X n ≅ ModuleCat.of B (Fin r → B)))
    (F : CochainComplex (Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)) ℤ)
    (hF : F.Acyclic)
    (α : (((constantSheaf U.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P) ⟶ F) :
    ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage U, ∀ j : 𝒰.I₀,
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B) (𝒰.f j)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map α) 0)
